name: SkillsMatrixEditor
tagline: The Skills Matrix Editor turns one text column into a full skills and certifications register for a person, technician, volunteer or crew.
description: The Skills Matrix Editor turns one text column into a full skills and certifications register for a person, technician, volunteer or crew. People rate each skill on a level scale, record certificate expiry dates and evidence notes, and see straight away how well they match a role profile.
features: Stored as JSON in one text column
